description: A manifest whose version carries a leading zero in a component (1.0.05) is refused: MAN-002's grammar admits exactly one spelling per version — the injectivity that keeps the string identifying an artifact and the triple ordering it (marketplace/1 MKT-050a) from disagreeing — and 1.0.05 is a second spelling of 1.0.5, not a distinct version.

errors.message: version MUST be a three-component digits-only dotted string with no leading zero in a component (MAN-002)
